scientific_integrity: All conclusions follow from an explicit identification of two join subcomplexes, their disconnected intersection, nullhomotopic join inclusions, and the homotopy pushout. Finite-field checks reproduce 234 small instances but are not substituted for the general argument.
scientific_limitations: Nonequivariant homotopy type only. The block alphabets must be disjoint and nonempty and source permutation families nonempty; the construction forbids interleavings. No uniqueness of splitting or integral symmetry characters are asserted. Published-priority comparison remains nonexhaustive.
title: Block-order reversal splitting for permutation complexes
